//: Build-free type checking of the renderer (renderer/**/*.js) — `npm run typecheck` / `test/contracts/typecheck.test.js`. The renderer files are classic <script src>s sharing ONE global scope: TS treats them as global scripts too (hence the `module.exports` guard is `Object.assign(module.exports, …)` and the guarded require is `module.require(…)` — TS does not see these as module markers). The type of `window.launcher` comes from preload.js `api` (renderer/globals.d.ts).
